% TeX Live 2025, doc/latex/circuitikz/circuitikzmanual.tex:2162-2171,
% Grounds anchors and customization. Replace the showanchors labels by short
% teal leader lines. Black leads attach to the symbols' electrical terminals.
% Native: tex/generic/circuitikz/pgfcircmonopoles.tex:62-93,183-215;
% bounds use the declared depth, not the ink extent or the text box.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{circuitikz}
\begin{document}
\begin{circuitikz}
  \begin{scope}
    \ctikzset{grounds/scale=1.6}
    \node[pground,blue,rotate=90,anchor=south,line width=0.6pt] (PE) at (2.75,1.4) {};
  \end{scope}
  \node[cground,red,rotate=-90,anchor=east,line width=0.6pt] (CH) at (4.85,1.0) {};
  \draw (0.35,1.4) -- (PE.north);
  \draw (6.05,1.35) -- (CH.right);
  \draw[teal,line width=0.6pt] (PE.north east) -- ++(0,0.48);
  \draw[teal,line width=0.6pt] (PE.south west) -- ++(0,-0.48);
  \draw[teal,line width=0.6pt] (CH.north west) -- ++(0,0.48);
  \draw[teal,line width=0.6pt] (CH.south east) -- ++(0,-0.48);
  \path[use as bounding box] (0,0) rectangle (6.4,2.8);
\end{circuitikz}
\end{document}
